expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is a staged milestone plan, not an implementation: TASKS.md has '任务总览' table of Task 0-8 each with 目标/实现要求/验收标准; CLAUDE.md instructs '一次只做当前 Task；实现范围以该 Task 的"实现要求"为准，不提前实现后续 Task' and '参考上游源码理解意图，但代码自己写'. No bocker script was written.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Every task ends with concrete verify commands plus expected output, e.g. Task 0: 'mount | grep /var/bocker # 输出包含 btrfs', 'stat -fc %T /sys/fs/cgroup/ # 输出 tmpfs（cgroups v1）', 'cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward # 1'; CLAUDE.md: '每个 Task 完成前必须逐条跑通"验收标准"'; plan includes final '毕业检验' running the full README example.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (docker-docker-shell): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror bocker's actual stages and code: functions bocker_check/init/images/rm/run/ps/logs/exec/commit/pull/help; concepts btrfs subvolume/CoW/reflink, chroot+unshare namespaces, veth/bridge/netns/NAT, cgroups v1 'cpu,cpuacct,memory'; tutorial-specific details: 'set -o errexit -o nounset -o pipefail; shopt -s nullglob', '#HELP' convention, BOCKER_CPU_SHARE/BOCKER_MEM_LIMIT, bridge0 10.0.0.1/24, Registry v1 dead→v2 adaptation, and the known bocker_init stray bocker_run bug.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: SHELL COMMANDS RUN (3) are only 'curl -sL .../bocker | tail -c 3000', 'ls -la ... && find ...', and greps on TASKS.md — no install commands. FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (2): CLAUDE.md, TASKS.md, both inside the project dir. Installs appear only as learner instructions ('安装 Lima（brew install lima）', apt-get in the VM provision script), which is allowed.
